description_en: Lists the trusted services for which the specified member account is a delegated administrator
description_zh: 查询指定成员被设置为哪些可信服务的委派管理员账号
name: ListDelegatedServicesForAccount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for retrieving the next page of results. Omit this parameter for the first request. If a previous response was truncated, pass the `NextToken` value from that response
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

DelegatedService.description_en:
The list of trusted services.

If the returned list is empty, the specified member account is not a delegated administrator account
DelegatedService.description_zh:
可信服务列表。

如果返回为空，则表示查询的成员不是委派管理员账号

items.description_en: Details of a delegated trusted service
items.description_zh:
可信服务信列表。

如果返回为空，则表示查询的成员不是委派管理员账号

DelegationEnabledTime.description_en: The timestamp when the member account was designated as a delegated administrator account
DelegationEnabledTime.description_zh: 设置为委派管理员账号的时间戳

ServicePrincipal.description_en: The identifier of the trusted service

Status.description_en:
The status of the trusted service. Valid values:

ENABLED: The integration with the trusted service is enabled.

DISABLED: The integration with the trusted service is disabled
Status.description_zh:
可信服务的启用状态。取值：

ENABLED：已启用。
DISABLED：未启用

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on a single page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

NextToken.description_en: The token for retrieving the next page of results. This parameter is returned only when the response is truncated, indicating that more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
NextToken.title_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
